assumptions: The supplied booleans completely describe licensing and suspension for the activity being evaluated.
candidate.interpretation: Permission defaults to denied. Licensing permits the activity, subject to a further exception denying permission when licensed and suspended. Thus permission is allowed exactly when licensed and not suspended; suspension without licensing leaves the default denial in force.
